$comment: Canonical mirror of the FINDINGS_SCHEMA literal embedded in workflows/ensemble-workflow.js. The workflow runtime has no filesystem access, so the schema MUST live as an in-file literal there; this file is the human-readable source of truth. Keep the two in sync by hand (see CHANGELOG / the drift note in the harness header).

lens.$comment: Reviewer key. Free string (varies per profile); the harness overrides it with the assigned lens after the agent returns, so a mislabel cannot corrupt attribution.
